answer: Require every agent to forge its identity inside a shared attestation lagoon: a newcomer only earns weight when several independent, long-lived peers vouch for it, and each voucher's signal weakens the more identities it sponsors. Spawning a second fake therefore costs not just a new bond but the diluted reputation of every sponsor it leans on - one extra identity costs one full bond plus a slice of each sponsor's standing, so a farm's marginal cost rises with every alias instead of staying flat.
